summary: Token Cat Ltd, a Beijing-based foreign private issuer formerly TuanChe Ltd, filed a routine Form 6-K containing its quarterly report for the period ended June 30, 2026, covering a two-segment business of advertising and resale of automotive electronic components. Disclosures reference ADS and warrant fair-value measurements tied to October 28, 2024 and November 23, 2022 instruments, plus a subsequent-event date of August 10, 2026 and a Class A ordinary share forecast date. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, go-private, spin-off, activist, or restructuring event is disclosed; this is ordinary periodic reporting without special-situation deal terms.
